maya (devex): Pushed a tiny change to package.json in the SDK and the NextJS edge sample started failing in preview with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED. Anyone seen this pattern recently?

jon (eng-runtime): What's your exports block?

maya (devex): This is what landed in release-candidate branch:
```json
"exports": {
  "./package.json": "./package.json",
  "./*": {
    "node": "./dist/cjs/*.cjs",
    "default": "./dist/esm/*.js"
  }
}
```

rachel (eng): Wildcard + conditionals. Edge builders (Vercel/Next) often don't honor the "node" condition and will attempt to map the package root to a concrete file. If there's no explicit "." mapping, resolution can fall through and produce ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED.

jon (eng-runtime): Repro: in an edge worker, `import { InferenceClient } from '@redwood/inference-sdk'` errors because the resolver can't map the bare specifier to a single path. Fix we applied in a hotfix branch was to add a top-level entry for ".":
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs",
    "default": "./dist/esm/index.js"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```
That made Vercel/Next bundle and worker deploy succeed.

maya (devex): Added that mapping locally and preview deploy passed. Will open PR.

rachel (eng): Also ensure "types": "dist/esm/index.d.ts" is set (TS language servers + bundlers look at that) and avoid relying on consumers importing deep subpaths like `@redwood/inference-sdk/dist/something` by explicitly exporting commonly used subpaths ("./client","./utils").

jon (eng-runtime): Can we add a CI job which runs an esbuild rollup and a node ESM import check against the published package layout? Something lightweight that would have caught this before the branch merged. Example commands: `esbuild examples/edge/main.ts --bundle --format=esm` and `node --input-type=module -e "import('@redwood/inference-sdk').then(()=>console.log('ok'))"`

maya (devex): I'll include a tiny sample-app smoke test in the PR and note the reason in the changelog. PR 3295 coming.

ops-bot: CI: preview/edge-samples failed on job: next-edge-preview. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/preview/3295

rachel (eng): Let's also add a short section to the SDK CONTRIBUTING.md about supported export conditions (import/require/browser/worker/default) and a snippet showing recommended minimal exports to cover node, browser, and edge bundlers.

jon (eng-runtime): Agreed. We should avoid "./*" patterns for public API surface. Use explicit subpath exports if consumers need to import specific files.

maya (devex): Thanks team — PR created with exports fix, types update, and a single esbuild smoke check. Will watch the CI and roll forward once green.
